name: Alpine
description: Alpine Linux is a minimal distribution built on musl and BusyBox that idles in well under 100 MB. This creates a VM from the official UEFI cloud image, which gives Alpine a kernel of its own -- the one thing an Alpine LXC cannot have.

notes.text: Cloud-Init is enabled by default. Configure your SSH key and credentials in the Proxmox Cloud-Init tab before starting the VM.
Alpine uses apk and OpenRC instead of apt and systemd. Enable a service with `rc-update add <service> default`.
